data.name: AuthenticationFailed
data.value: Authentication failed. Check username, password / app password and access for the selected protocol, then retry.

data.name: ConfigureHint
data.value: Select IMAP or POP3 and enter your mail server, port, TLS mode and username in Settings → Mail reader, then enter a password in Account and credentials and refresh. Changing connection settings clears this inbox.

data.name: ConnectionFailed
data.value: Connection or retrieval failed. Check network and server settings, then refresh to retry. Messages already loaded in this session remain readable.

data.name: CredentialHint
data.value: Saved credentials are read when refreshing. Unsaved passwords last only for this session and never enter ordinary settings.

data.name: CredentialSaved
data.value: Credential saved in protected system storage.

data.name: InvalidConfiguration
data.value: Invalid connection settings. Check server, username, port (1–65535) and TLS mode.

data.name: Loaded
data.value: Loaded {0} messages. Select one from the list.

data.name: Loading
data.value: Connecting and reading the latest 100 messages…

data.name: PasswordRequired
data.value: Complete connection settings and enter a password / app password.

data.name: Port
data.value: Port (IMAP TLS usually 993; POP3 TLS usually 995; check provider)

data.name: SelectHint
data.value: Select a message in the sidebar to read it.

data.name: SessionOnly
data.value: Secure storage is unavailable, locked or denied. Session mode only: passwords are not saved; enter them again after restart.

data.name: TlsFailed
data.value: TLS connection or certificate validation failed. Check server, port, TLS mode and system clock, then retry.

data.name: Pop3IdentityFailed
data.value: The POP3 server does not support UIDL or returned invalid message identifiers. Contact your provider or use IMAP.

data.name: AttachmentSaveFailed
data.value: Unable to save. Choose a writable folder and an unused filename. Uncached attachments are unavailable offline.

data.name: InlineImageUnavailable
data.value: Inline image missing, invalid or unsupported

data.name: CacheLoaded
data.value: Loaded {0} cached messages; readable offline if refresh fails.

data.name: CacheSaved
data.value: Local cache updated; messages remain readable if refresh fails.

data.name: CacheReadFailed
data.value: Unable to read local cache or its contents are invalid. Try refreshing online.

data.name: CacheWriteFailed
data.value: Unable to save cache. Previous disk cache is preserved; new messages are available only in this session.

data.name: AttachmentOffline
data.value: Attachment not cached. Refresh online before saving.
